subject: Post-demo: Billing path, VAT and PO vs card follow-up
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantiflow.io>, procurement@quantiflow.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T16:10:00Z
Subject: Post-demo recap + billing ops questions

Hi Elena / Quantiflow procurement team —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap + the asks we agreed to pick up on: 

1) Preferred commercial path: you mentioned procurement will drive a PO for enterprise terms but might also use the Azure marketplace for faster onboarding. Can you confirm primary preference (PO vs marketplace vs card)?

2) Invoice requirements: please confirm the billing contact and exact billing address you expect on invoices, whether you require VAT/Tax ID on the invoice, and any special line-item language needed ("Cloud services", "Redwood Inference subscription", etc.).

3) Net terms: you referenced net 60 in the call. Please confirm net days and whether Quantiflow needs a supplier/vendor form or W9 equivalent for EU compliance.

4) Attachments: I’m attaching a sample Redwood invoice layout and our standard commercial terms to speed ops review. If you have a PO template, please share — we can prefill fields to avoid back-and-forth.

Next steps I propose: 
- You confirm procurement path + billing details (reply) — ideally by EOD Friday 7/16.
- If PO is chosen, procurement sends PO to procurement@redwood.com, we’ll acknowledge and queue SOW/DocuSign.
- If marketplace preferred, we’ll confirm SKU & pricing cadence and send marketplace-specific invoice mapping.

If there’s an internal billing contact who should receive invoices directly, please loop them in. Happy to connect our billing ops folks on a short call if that helps.

Thanks —

Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-invoice-sample.pdf (sample invoice layout), redwood-commercial-terms.pdf
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantiflow.io>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@quantiflow.com
Date: 2026-07-13T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + billing ops questions

Hi Olga —

Great demo — thanks. Quick answers below from procurement and finance: 

- Primary path: We prefer a PO for enterprise deals. Marketplace is an option for pilot projects but procurement will still request the PO to record spend.
- Net terms: Net 60 is acceptable for us — please note we can only process invoices once the PO is matched in our system.
- VAT/Tax: Quantiflow is VAT-registered in Italy. Please include our VAT ID on invoices: IT12345678901.
- Billing address (for legal/invoice):
  Quantiflow S.p.A.
  Via San Marco 45
  20121 Milan, Italy

- Billing contact: finance.ap@quantiflow.com (cc’d here)

I’m attaching our PO template; happy for you to prefill and return. Procurement will aim to issue a signed PO within 7–10 business days once we have the SOW/price table.

One question: do you support VAT reverse-charge lines if needed, and can you supply invoices with both EUR and GBP breakdowns? Our tax team sometimes requests multi-currency visibility.

Thanks —
Elena
Head of Product Ops | Quantiflow
elena.rossi@quantiflow.io

Attachments: quantiflow-po-template.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantiflow.io>, finance.ap@quantiflow.com
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + billing ops questions

Hi Elena / finance team —

Thanks for the details — quick replies from our side: 

- We can include VAT ID on every invoice and support reverse-charge notation when appropriate; we’ll add a VAT line and the VAT ID field in the invoice footer.
- Multi-currency: we can provide an invoice with a EUR primary amount and an optional GBP conversion line for your tax team. Official settlement will follow the currency in the invoice unless otherwise agreed in the PO.
- PO handling: we’ll prefill the PO you attached and return a draft to procurement@quantiflow.com for signature. Once signed, procurement@redwood.com will route to our billing ops to match and schedule.

Operational asks for faster processing: 
- Please include a single PO number on every invoice PDF so your AP system can auto-match.
- If Quantiflow requires a specific line-item (e.g., "Redwood inference runtime - monthly"), list it in the PO and we’ll mirror it on the invoice.

Dev (cc) will check whether Marketplace SKUs are already published for the enterprise package and can provide SKUs and pricing mapping.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: procurement@quantiflow.com
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantiflow.io>
Date: 2026-07-14T07:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + billing ops questions

Hi Marissa / Olga —

Thanks — procurement here. Two quick follow-ups: 

1) Marketplace: for speed we are evaluating Azure Marketplace first; can you confirm Redwood’s current availability on Azure marketplace and provide SKU(s) and the marketplace billing cadence (monthly vs upfront)?
2) Supplier onboarding: we require a supplier form (tax ID verification + bank details). Can you send your vendor onboarding packet or a link to your supplier portal?

If you can provide the marketplace SKU + a prefilled PO by EOD, we’ll route for signature faster.

Best,
Procurement Team
procurement@quantiflow.com
